item.description:
Asobi 1.0 (build 2104) Nov 2, 2026

  • Kitsu gets each note once. While you host, notes go to Kitsu only if Kitsu doesn't already have them. Notes sent from an earlier link of the same session, or pasted into Kitsu by hand, aren't sent again.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 2102) Nov 2, 2026

  • Notes on a conform's shots go to Kitsu. A shot matched to Kitsu now sends its notes to the shot's Compositing task, live while you host a review and with Review ▸ Kitsu ▸ Publish. Each comment names the movie, its timecode and the frame within the shot. Comments brought in from Frame.io stay out.
  • Comment subtitles for everyone. While hosting, Review ▸ Comment Subtitles for Everyone (or the Show menu's Comment subtitles) turns them on for every Mac, page and phone in the room, at your position unless someone chose their own. Turning it off, or leaving, puts them back.
  • Fixed: joining a review of cut movies could show "Proxy stream failed… Cannot Open". A guest now waits for the host's copy of the movie, tries again, and says why if it can't get it.

1.0 (build 2098) Nov 2, 2026

  • Set the timecode a movie starts at. Playback ▸ Source ▸ Start Timecode…, or right-click the timecode in the bar: one click for 00:00:00:00, 01:00:00:00, 00:59:50:00 (10 s countdown) or 00:58:00:00 (bars, slate and countdown), or type any timecode. Line Up makes the frame on screen read the timecode you type, for picture after a slate or countdown. From the File goes back to the movie's own. Saved with the session; in a live review the page and phones follow.
  • Notes read the movie's timecode. The note timecodes, "Note at…" and the Whole movie list now match the burn-in (01:00:12:06, not 00:00:12:06).

1.0 (build 2093) Nov 2, 2026

  • Every comment of a cut movie in one list. The Notes tab gains This shot / Whole movie: every note and marked frame on every shot of the playlist's cut movies, the movie on screen first, shot by shot. Click a timecode to go to that shot at that frame (in a live review the room follows); the comment at the playhead is lit. The web page's notes drawer has the same list.
  • Comment subtitles are in the bar's Show menu too, with their position.

1.0 (build 2089) Nov 2, 2026

  • Every shot of a long cut movie fits in the strip. With many short shots, the strip could run past the window, hiding the last few shots of the last movie; they could only be reached with the arrow keys.

1.0 (build 2086) Nov 2, 2026

  • Comments as subtitles. Press U, or use Subtitles in the bar, to show each note over the picture as it plays: the author's name, then the words, held long enough to read. Notes on the same frame show together; resolved notes don't show. Off until you turn it on. Show ▸ Comment Subtitles ▸ Position puts them in any of nine places.
  • Lighter web links for a cut movie. Shots no longer get review copies of their own: the page, guest Macs and the phone play the movie's one stream, so sharing takes seconds, not one encode per shot.
  • Guests who join a web link made with this build need Asobi 1.0 (2079) or later on their Mac.

1.0 (build 2079) Nov 2, 2026

Asobi 1.0 (build 2079)

  • A cut movie's review opens on any Mac. A shot is now saved as its movie and its frames, not as a link that lived only on the Mac that cut it, so a session of shots opens wherever the movie can be reached (a colleague's Mac saw "Looking for 67 clips that moved"). Earlier sessions open as they are.
  • Live reviews of a cut movie. Guests on Macs see the same shots, in your order, at your frame: a Mac that reaches the movie builds them over it, any other fetches the movie's review copy once. A guest on an older Asobi is named in a notice asking them to update.
  • Guests land where you are. Going to a shot's first comment takes the room there, not to the shot's first frame; a single-frame step reaches stopped guests; a guest that joins gets every clip's notes and marks, not only the clip you were on.
  • Click from comment to comment. Click a clip in the strip to go to its first note or mark, click it again for the next. Clicking the shot you were on no longer jumps to the start of the whole movie.
  • Fold a cut movie in the Playlist. The arrow beside the movie folds its shots into one row that shows the movie in small, with its cuts, notes and marks; Option-click folds every movie.
  • Kitsu notes answered here are answered in Kitsu. Resolving one acknowledges the comment as you; a reply goes into its thread. A comment someone has answered in Kitsu is never replaced or removed by a live review: changes go up as an update.
  • The title bar names the shot on screen while a cut movie plays on.

1.0 (build 2060) Nov 2, 2026

  • See where the notes are on every shot. The clip strip above the timeline shows each clip's notes (yellow ticks along the foot) and marked frames (white ticks along the top) on every clip, not only the one on screen, so a cut movie's band gives the whole picture at a glance.
